properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDSA-P256 is the sole transaction-authorization mechanism of this mini-Bitcoin chain: NewUTXOTransaction → SignTransaction → Transaction.Sign; MineBlock → VerifyTransaction → Transaction.Verify. Keys live in Wallet.PrivateKey (gob-persisted to Wallet.dat — see the key-management finding). Module go_prj22_Bitcoin, Go 1.18.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Auto-generated Solidity build output committed to the repo (Hardhat/Foundry artifacts for the AaveFlashswap flashloan demo and the Chainflag BoxGame CTF). These files record that every compiled contract executes keccak256 on-chain (function selectors, revert-error selectors), and that the toolchain commits source files by keccak256 digest — but the files themselves configure nothing at runtime and are regenerated by the compiler. Keccak-256 is the EVM's fixed protocol hash: replaceable only by t

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-256 is the chain's workhorse hash: PoW security, merkle roots, tx IDs and address hashing all depend on it; it is also the pre-step of the RIPEMD-160 address pipeline (wallet.go:76).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: crypto/rand.Reader is the sole entropy source for keygen and ECDSA nonce generation in this project.
